purpose: Static vocabulary for search-coverage-gap-auditor: stopword list, miss-cause taxonomy (label/definition/evidence/repair), cause priority, and field-name aliases.

C01.label: in-pool, unmatched
C01.definition: The record is already inside the retained pool, but identifier/metadata differences kept it below the alignment threshold. Retrieval succeeded; alignment failed.
C01.evidence: matched pool record id + normalised title similarity + both DOI values
C01.repair: alignment repair: re-run the tiered matcher, auto-accept above threshold, queue the rest for human adjudication

C02.label: pool truncation / ranking cutoff
C02.definition: The query reported more hits than the records retained, so the record can sit below the retained cutoff. Attribution points at a specific query and its retained depth.
C02.repair: raise retrieval depth (max_k) for the named query and re-screen the deeper result list

C03.label: source recall failure
C03.definition: A query was topically able to match the record (term overlap above the capability threshold) and its filters admitted the record, yet the named source returned nothing for it.
C03.repair: re-issue the named query verbatim on the named source and check venue indexing coverage

C04.label: time-window truncation
C04.definition: The record's year falls outside the year filter of every capable query, or outside the organizer scope window.
C04.repair: re-run the named query with the year filter widened to cover the reference year

C05.label: field restriction
C05.definition: The query's terms would match the record, but the query restricted searching to fields (e.g. abstract only) that exclude where the match occurs (e.g. title).
C05.evidence: query_id + declared search fields + field where the overlap occurs
C05.repair: relax the restrictive field filter (title+abstract+keywords) for the named query

C06.label: query term gap
C06.definition: No query in the log contains the record's distinctive terms or a synonym of them, so no query could reach it.
C06.evidence: list of uncovered terms + nearest query + query vocabulary size
C06.repair: add the uncovered term group (synonyms) to the query and re-run

C07.label: source not covered
C07.definition: The record lives in a database/index that no query targeted.
C07.evidence: reference source + set of queried sources
C07.repair: add the missing source to the search and re-screen its hits

C08.label: language/filter exclusion
C08.definition: A language or document-type restriction excluded the record although the query was otherwise able to reach it.
C08.repair: re-run without the language restriction, or add a translated query

C09.label: citation route unused
C09.definition: The record is reachable by one citation hop from material already retained (it is cited by, or cites, an included record), but no snowballing step was recorded.
C09.evidence: citation edge [citing, cited] + graph file path
C09.repair: backward+forward citation snowballing from the named included paper

C10.label: reference record anomaly
C10.definition: The reference record itself is problematic: missing/malformed DOI, missing year, duplicate record, retracted or not retrievable. Coverage accounting is affected, not the search strategy.
C10.evidence: anomaly flag + exclusion rule + raw reference fields
C10.repair: verify reference identity (DOI/title/authorship) before counting it as retrievable; report it separately

C11.label: no retrieval pool
C11.definition: No retrieved records were supplied or retained, so no miss can be attributed to a query.
C11.repair: run the planned queries and record query text, source and retrieved_at for each

C12.label: undetermined
C12.definition: The retained evidence does not support any concrete cause. Left open on purpose instead of guessing.
C12.repair: human adjudication with the missing evidence listed
